fields.description: Default country for TaxMate SaaS tenants. UAE regional features activate when Company country matches this value.
fields.label: Default Country

fields.description: When enabled, Company / Customer / Supplier Tax ID must be a 15-digit UAE TRN when the party or company is in the UAE.
fields.label: Enforce TRN Validation

fields.description: When enabled, Address records for the UAE must include an Emirate (Place of Supply).
fields.label: Require Emirate on UAE Address

fields.description: When enabled, block submitting e-invoices until the Company UAE readiness checklist is complete.
fields.label: Block E-Invoice Until Company Ready

fields.description: Require Place of Supply (Emirate) on Sales Invoices for UAE companies (VAT 201 Box 1).
fields.label: Require Emirate on Sales Invoice

fields.description: Require Return Against or External Return Against (and a reason) on UAE Credit Notes.
fields.label: Enforce Credit Note Reference

fields.default:
TaxMate UAE VAT setup checklist. After creating a Company with country United Arab Emirates:

1. Set Company Tax ID (TRN).
2. Confirm UAE VAT 5% / Zero / Exempted tax templates.
3. Link VAT accounts in UAE VAT Settings.
4. Set Emirate on the company Address.
5. Use Simplified or Detailed Tax Invoice print formats.
6. File returns via the UAE VAT 201 report.
fields.label: Onboarding Notes
